assumptions: System A over {a} and over {a,b} modulo commutation
meta.falsification: Any failure of a semiring axiom, or commuting compositions for all two-symbol samples.
meta.hypothesis: Endomorphisms of {a}* (substitutions a -> w) with pointwise juxtaposition (f+g)(u) = f(u)g(u) and composition form a commutative semiring isomorphic to (N, +, x) via f -> f(a). With two symbols modulo commutation, composition is no longer commutative.
meta.methodology: Represent an endomorphism by the image of a (a word). Implement substitution and juxtaposition on strings only; check every semiring axiom on all images a^0..a^K; check the length map is a homomorphism. For {a,b}/commutation, sample substitutions and look for non-commuting compositions.
meta.question: Is there a second operation on unary numerals that arises from transformations alone?
meta.title: Endomorphisms of the one-symbol free monoid form the semiring of natural numbers
